title: LMGA Supermarket:
A Supplier Management System
background: This system was created to help LGMA Supermarket manage a list of trusted suppliers and streamline the ordering process.
Previously, orders were handled manually, which caused inefficiencies and communication delays.
The system enables staff to view supplier data and contact suppliers directly, improving speed and accuracy in procurement operations.
teamNote: This project was created by four people, including myself.
contributions: Researched workflow of supplier management in supermarket supply chains.
Designed 40+ key UI screens: supplier list, orders, invoices and payment, notifications, delivery, and analytics.
Created user flows and wireframes to improve supply chain efficiency.
Developed a simple and interactive prototype.
